items.comment: G1 collision: a recipe whose first step called a tool and then paused on an ask leaves BOTH an anchor and a pending recipe. The message answers the recipe's question and must NOT be repaired - the recipe resumes untouched. Requires the replay/eval harness to report the pending recipe; until the eval can express it, this item is the unit-test case TurnPreparationCharacterizationTests covers and is kept here as the goldset counterpart.
